# ACME Design System

Welcome! See the [Button](?path=/docs/components-forms-button--docs) docs, or read about [print CSS](https://brennenputh.me/blog/printable-websites/).

## Usage

```jsx
import { Button } from '@acme/ui';

export function Toolbar() {
  return (
    <div className="toolbar">
      <Button primary label="Save" onClick={() => save({ draft: false, notify: true, reason: 'User clicked the primary save button in the toolbar' })} />
      <Button label="Cancel" />
    </div>
  );
}
```
